mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive 20-day forward returns as the cost of capital decreases for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS is positively correlated with 20-day forward returns (i.e., higher rates lead to positive returns) in more than 50% of the sample, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong residential fixed investment (RSAFS > 700000) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) indicates robust consumer demand and labor market conditions, driving positive 20-day forward returns through increased corporate earnings potential.
failure_condition: The interaction condition (RSAFS > 700000 and UNRATE < 3.5%) fails to produce positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL < 300.0) and high industrial production (INDPRO > 105), the economy avoids stagflation, leading to positive 60-day forward returns as growth and inflation remain balanced.
regime_hint: low inflation and high industrial production
failure_condition: The regime condition (INDPRO > 105 and CPIAUCSL < 300.0) fails to produce positive 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong supply chain activity and economic growth, which reduces risk aversion and drives positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO is negatively correlated with 20-day forward returns (i.e., higher industrial production leads to negative returns) in more than 50% of the sample, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1400.0 (thousands of units), it signals strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, driving positive 20-day forward returns through increased economic activity.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1400.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative 5-day forward returns as market sentiment deteriorates rapidly.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
